name: hud_cmd_bind_button_base_clear_binding_entries
description: HudCmdBindButtonBase::ClearBindingEntries frees each command-binding display string, deletes each binding entry, clears the occupied slots, and resets bindingVec.end to bindingVec.begin.
known_limits: VC byte verification does not currently match: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs failed for 0x40c1d0 with 122 unmasked mismatches after masking 12 relocation bytes and trimming 9 NOPs.
functional_evidence: Native smoke verifies two binding entries are deleted, occupied slots are nulled, begin/capacity are preserved, and end is reset to begin.
Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40c1d0 shows per-entry displayText free, operator delete, slot nulling, and bindingVec.end reset to bindingVec.begin.
